messages:
Priya: FYI — rolling alert spike for 429s since 08:10 UTC after we toggled the new burst policy. customers /org/* are most affected, reported from US-east region.
Luca: Seeing it in the RL dashboard too. spike around 08:08, ~3k 429s/min for 5m. top paths: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings.
Priya: Example from a customer report: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` body: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":15} headers: x-rw-rl-limit:100, x-rw-rl-remaining:0, x-rw-rl-reset:164
Alex: Confirmed in edge logs — many short bursts of concurrent connections from a handful of API keys. Looks like clients that do batch-y traffic hit the new per-key burst cap.
Luca: Which policy did we flip? I thought we staged the algorithmic burst token bucket to 0.2s refill for pilot tenants.
Priya: We enabled the new "burst-smoothing" policy for Tier-Beta (pilot) at 08:05. The rollout rule targeted org IDs matching beta list.
Nina: Product received two support escalations — one customer says production traffic dropped ~40% because clients immediately backoff and then throttle longer than before. They want an emergency override.
Priya: Can we repro locally with the same header patterns? I can share a sample replay.
Luca: Yes — I ran a replay with the same concurrency profile. Repro steps: `wrk -t16 -c200 --script burst.lua --latency https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate` — when burst-smoothing enabled, we see many 429s and longer exponential backoff behavior.
Priya: Repro snippet for ops team:
```
# simulate client burst
for i in {1..400}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer REPLAY_KEY" https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate &
done
```
Alex: Quick mitigation options: 1) Temporarily widen per-key burst window (admin API) 2) Roll the policy back for pilot orgs 3) Short TTL override on the gateway to treat these orgs as legacy.
Luca: Metrics to monitor after mitigation: rate_limit.429.count, rl_bucket_fill_rate, rl_concurrent_bursts, p50/p95 latency for affected orgs. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.org/d/rl-policy/rl-policy-overview?orgId=1
Priya: I propose emergency plan: first do a 30m temporary override (widen burst by 3x) for affected orgs, then observe for 15m; if still bad, rollback policy. Any objections?
Nina: Product OK with 30m override as long as we log it and inform CS to notify customers. Also ask CS to throttle their support template to advise clients to add jitter/backoff.
Alex: I can apply override via admin CLI: `rw-admin set-org-limit --org org_123 --burst-multiplier 3 --expires-in 1800` — will push in 2m after we get ack.
Luca: Before we change, capture baseline metrics and a short packet capture of edge responses. Also add a synthetic client to run a replay for observation.
Priya: Action list: 1) Alex apply override at 08:24 UTC 2) Luca capture baseline & start synthetic at 08:22 3) Nina coord with CS and the two affected customers 4) Priya will monitor and coordinate rollback window.
Alex: Doing override now. cc @RateLimitBot to note change.
RateLimitBot: Policy override applied: org=org_123, burst_multiplier=3, expires_in=1800s, initiated_by=Alex, at=2026-02-11T08:24:12Z 
Luca: After override p50 latency for org_123 dropped from 420ms -> 210ms and 429s dropped to ~80/min from 3k/min within 60s. Looks promising.
Nina: CS notified customers and sent the temporary mitigation message. Product wants post-mortem to adjust rollout thresholds (increase grace tokens for batching clients).
Priya: Agreed. Post-mortem owners: Luca (tech), Nina (product), Alex (ops). Deliverables: timeline, root cause, customer impact table, and a safer ramp plan for burst-sensitive clients. Due EOD tomorrow.
Luca: Also suggest we add a pre-rollout smoke check: run a 5-min simulated burst against sampled orgs and verify 429s < 1% of baseline. We can integrate into rollout pipeline.
Priya: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated — will post rollback log if we revert. :thumbsup:
Alex: If anyone needs to roll back manually: `rw-admin revert-policy --policy burst-smoothing --target org_123` (auth required).
Priya: Closing loop: override expires at 08:54 UTC; if we don't see regression we will schedule a controlled re-roll with increased token burst for pilot.
